assets.name: cream-coral
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: one of a coordinated series of app marketplace screenshot BACKGROUND PLATES for the HarmonyOS rhythm-practice app OneBeat. Output one portrait 9:16 artwork, ideally 1080x1920. Input image 1 is ONLY the brand color, comic print texture and analogue ink-style reference; do not copy its lettering or disc logo. Input image 2 is ONLY the character-linework and mood reference; do not include its characters. Primary request: an art-directed premium printed editorial background that will sit BEHIND a very large upright smartphone. There must be NO phone, no phone-shaped panel, no UI, no device, no letters, no text, no numbers, no logo, no badges. The final phone will be composited later at x=140..940, y=410..2140 on a 1080x1920 canvas, so the middle is mostly hidden; concentrate the few decorative details on the left/right outer 140px margins and bottom corners, using broad sweeping shapes that read on the visible edges. Keep the entire top 0..350px beautifully calm and almost empty for future copy. Brand style: cream paper, hand-printed flat color, restrained offset ink grain, playful but mature, bold simple shapes with occasional fine near-black sketch contour, no glossy 3D, no floating UI, no product photography, no dense pattern, no literal musical notes, no generic techno waveform, no radial comic explosion. The phone screen will be primary; this background must support it with visual breathing space. Make one finished professional coherent composition, not a grid or collage of alternative designs. Theme 1 / series opener. Warm ivory paper #FFF9EE base; one generous coral orange #FF7056 ribbon-like arc sweeps diagonally upward from the lower left across the lower half and exits right at y~1500; its broad cream inner region keeps the center gentle. A small muted lilac patch tucked against the right edge at mid-height, and 2 sparse small teal hand-ink beat marks down the outer left edge. The coral should be an organic confident screenprint gesture, not a circular target. Very sparse fine paper grain, cheerful sophisticated rhythm. Keep the top quarter ivory and completely free of decoration.
